findings.detail: The Swallow is male in the source and in the established glossary, but this passage uses feminine pronouns; the translation also alternates between feminine and masculine references elsewhere. Preserve the character's male identity consistently, adjusting Russian syntax around the grammatically feminine name as needed.

source_anchor.quote: His friends had gone away to Egypt six weeks before, but he had stayed behind

translation_anchor.quote: Её друзья улетели в Египет шесть недель назад, а она осталась

findings.detail: Here “Reeds” refers to the other personified Reeds, reinforcing the joke that the beloved has many relations. The uncountable generic “тростника” loses that implication; use the plural of the established character name, for example «Тростинок».

source_anchor.quote: and indeed the river was quite full of Reeds.

translation_anchor.quote: и впрямь река была полна тростника.

findings.detail: The source says the Prince is no longer golden, not merely that he no longer looks golden. The gold has been removed; state that directly.

source_anchor.quote: The ruby has fallen out of his sword, his eyes are gone, and he is golden no longer

translation_anchor.quote: Рубин выпал из его меча, глаз у него нет, да и золотым он больше не выглядит
